items.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
items.description: The man accused of trying to take over the Israel-bound jet is named as Hamam al-Hammami by several media outlets.

items.title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
items.description: The strike on Northern Bridge comes after repeat attacks on another major bridge in recent days.

items.title: Protesters across Spain demand action over housing crisis
items.description: More than 50 protests are planned to take place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.

items.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
items.description: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

items.title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
items.description: As of Thursday night, Pike remained critically ill and is being treated at a hospital in Nashville, Tennessee.

items.title: Women given shorts at Oktoberfest to prevent upskirting
items.description: The step at the Munich festival comes after thousands of voyeuristic videos emerged on social media.

items.title: Kim wins Asian Games gold to secure military exemption
items.description: Golfer Tom Kim wins gold at the Asian Games to secure an exemption from mandatory service in South Korea's military.

items.title: UK-Iranian dual national bailed after RAF Fairford incident arrest
items.description: The 25-year-old man was arrested in the London borough of Westminster on Thursday.

items.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
items.description: About 735 schools have faced disruption as violent protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

items.title: Cornell frat house rape accuser 'under siege' online, says lawyer
items.description: A lawyer for Jane Doe says she is "not doing well" amid attempts to uncover her identity.

items.title: US road rage killer's sentence quashed because AI video of victim was shown in court
items.description: The Arizona appeals court ruled that airing an AI message from the dead victim "crossed that line".

items.title: Hawaii's iconic 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch collapses
items.description: The lava rock formation protruding from the rocky cliffs of Volcanoes National Park crumbled some time last weekend.

items.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
items.description: President Lee Jae Myung also accused Kyiv of "attempting to provoke a war on the Korean Peninsula".

items.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
items.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

items.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
items.description: Capt Smit Machchhar tells Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi he opened the cockpit door to let others in during the attack.

items.title: OpenAI fires workers for 'mishandling sensitive information'
items.description: The former employees were investigated for sharing data with an outside AI evaluation group.

items.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
items.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

items.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as northern conflict escalates
items.description: The diplomatic fallout comes as Ethiopian forces battle rebel fighters across its northern region.

items.title: Australia says platforms like Steam and Roblox have 'significant' child safety gaps
items.description: Fortnite and Minecraft also told to 'lift their game' by online safety regulator.

items.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
items.description: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.
